inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum is being treated as a threat, but the real pressure comes from the federal government allowing renegotiations over the 2009 agreement to drag on. The prolonged uncertainty does not seem accidental: keeping university workers divided and the dispute unresolved benefits those who want a weakened union. Now the warning of nationwide disruption can be used to blame workers rather than those who allowed the standoff to continue.
